ops.title: ccp doctor: report orphaned File Provider domains (CloudStorage dir with no account row)
ops.description: P1c(iii), deferred from the 2026-07-07 incident. fusekit v0.34.0 shipped the readiness + teardown fixes that PREVENT new orphans; this surfaces EXISTING ones (the acct-13 leftover). domainFor = filepath.Base(accountDir); cross-ref m.Store.ListAccounts() ConfigDir basenames; slot beside reportOrphanedHolder in internal/cli/doctor.go. See fusekit ccn 7818f6d, cc-pool ccn 064315a.

ops.text: doctor enumerates ~/Library/CloudStorage/CCPoolStatus-acct-* and reports any domain whose acct-NN has no matching account row
advisory only: never removes an FP domain (tearing down a live domain is the finding-1 hazard); a healthy account is not flagged; has a table-driven test
